name: Real-world questions (RWQ)
description: RWQ is a benchmark comprising 20,772 authentic user inquiries designed to evaluate large language models' semantic comprehension in a real-world setting. It supports an RWQ-Elo rating system that ranks models based on competitive two-player matches judged by GPT-4.
reputation: A newer real-world QA benchmark that has gained attention for using authentic user questions and Elo-style model ranking.
notes: Introduces a new evaluation system that better reflects real-world usage compared to multiple choice QA.
